raw.query: WITH ledger AS (SELECT id, feeds, raw FROM provenance.ledger_entry WHERE id = 978), accuracy AS (SELECT model, mode, AVG(wape) AS avg_wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE span = 'common' AND candidate = 'point' AND resolution = '15s' AND model IN ('chronos', 'toto') GROUP BY model, mode) SELECT (SELECT feeds FROM ledger) AS ledger_feeds, (SELECT json_object_agg(model || '/' || mode, ROUND(avg_wape::numeric, 5)) FROM accuracy) AS accuracies
raw.observed: Chronos-2 is 120M params, Toto-2.0 is 2.5B params (20.8x larger). On common 15s point forecasts, Toto/cov has WAPE 0.54677, beating Chronos/cov (WAPE 0.55180).
raw.claimed: The table quotes Chronos-2 deliberately: at 120M parameters it is the smallest of the three (Toto-2.0 is 20x larger), so the headline rests on the cheapest forecaster, not the most accurate.
raw.evidence: Ledger 978 and v_cost_ratio confirm Chronos-2 is the cheapest forecaster computationally (120M params vs Toto's 2.5B params, or 20.8x larger), and forecast_metrics confirms Toto is more accurate (0.54677 vs 0.55180 WAPE).
